query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deployment_exposed_port(deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL, port INTEGER NOT NULL, port_type TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT deployment_exposed_port_chk_port_type_enum CHECK(port_type IN ('http')),  PRIMARY KEY(deployment_id, port, port_type), FOREIGN KEY(deployment_id) REFERENCES deployment(id), CONSTRAINT deployment_exposed_port_chk_port_range CHECK(port > 0 AND port <= 65535));
